reviews.text:
The blush color is really pretty, but it can’t be applied too thickly—it melts easily. I actually get a nicer finish using my fingers than using a brush, but it’s not very easy to work with, so it’s not beginner-friendly.

I mainly chose this because the packaging is super cute and I thought it would be convenient to carry for touch-ups, but in reality it works better as something you apply before setting your makeup. Otherwise, it smudges/melts too easily or looks too heavy… or maybe I just don’t know the best way to use it.
reviews.zh:
胭脂顏色好靚，但唔可以塗太厚，好容易化開。其實用手指上妝嘅效果仲靚過用掃，但唔算易用，所以唔適合新手。

我揀呢個主要係因為包裝好可愛，以為方便攜帶補妝，但實際上比較適合定妝前用。否則好容易化開、溶埋一齊或者顯得太厚重……又或者只係我唔識用啫。

reviews.text: I use this product as a on the go touch up for blush/bronzer and it works well! The formula is putty, similar to the blushes, but less thick/matifying IMO. it has a buildable coverage and blends easy with a finger or silicone applicator. the lasting power isn't incredible, but used as a touch up product it's convienent and useful.
reviews.zh: 我用呢個產品作為胭脂／bronzer嘅外出補妝，好用！質地係黏土狀，同胭脂類似，但係我覺得冇咁厚同霧面。遮瑕度可以逐層疊加，用手指或者矽膠掃都好易推開。持久力就唔算勁，但作為補妝產品就好方便實用。

reviews.text: The colours in this palette are really unique and pretty however I wish they were more pigmented. I'm the lightest shade in pretty much every brand I buy and I honestly don't see this working for anyone darker than me which is the vast majority of people.
reviews.zh: 呢個盤嘅顏色好特別好靚，但可惜唔夠顯色。我喺每個品牌都買最淺色，但我真係睇唔到呢個盤適合比我深嘅膚色用，而呢個情況佔咗絕大部分人。

reviews.text: A cute product that is perfect for taking with you. The colours are unique and cool toned which I love. Hard to get a brush to pick up the product but works well with your fingers. I also used this for eye shadow and it worked great.
reviews.zh: 產品好可愛，方便攜帶。顏色特別又係冷調，我好鍾意。掃好難沾到產品，但用手指就好好用。我仲用咗嚟做眼影，效果好好。

reviews.text: I love this little palette so much. The texture is fun, and easy to apply and blend. All the shades are suitable for me, I appreciate that they are sorted by seasonal color so that each shade can be worn. Perfect for traveling since it doesn't take up too much room
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個小盤。質地有趣，輕易上妝同推開。所有色都啱我用，好欣賞佢按季節色分開，每隻色都用得著。旅行一流，唔佔位。

reviews.text:
I actually keep this one and the cooler light toned one on my car keys(I don't recommend because it's a bit bulky to have both on your keys) 
 As per usual you will need to build the color of you want to get them as bright as my swatches. But they are super easy to blend as a result of the light pigmentations, which is always a plus for us no makeup makeup girlies.
reviews.zh:
我其實將呢個同一個冷調淺色嗰個掛喺車匙上面（唔建議，因為兩個一齊掛喺鎖匙有啲笨重）
同平時一樣，如果想做到好似我試色咁鮮明，就要逐層疊加顏色。但因為顯色度低，所以超級易推開，對我哋呢啲鍾意偽素顏妝嘅女仔嚟講永遠係加分。

reviews.text:
ころんとした丸いフォルムがfweeっぽくてあいかわらず見た目が可愛い〜！
触ってみるとむにむにした柔らかさがあって、少ししっとりしつつも馴染ませるとさらっと質感に変化するからムラになりにくかったです。
あと、左上にスカイブルーの爽やかなカラーがセットされてて、他の3色の上から青みを足せるのも調整しやすくてよきでした。
reviews.zh:
圓碌碌嘅圓形輪廓好有fwee嘅感覺，樣依然好可愛〜！
摸落有軟糯嘅柔軟感，帶少少滋潤，但推開之後質地會變成清爽feel，所以好難搽到唔均勻。
另外，左上角有隻sky blue嘅清新色，可以疊喺其他3色上面加藍調，調整都好方便，幾好。

reviews.text: Color looks almost identical on all of them. Way too white on my skin tone. I’m only a medium light. They all look super white on me. Color payoff is no good and it doesn’t blend smoothly. Sad that I paid for this and didn’t love it. Packaging is amazing though.
reviews.zh: 顏色喺每一個色號睇起嚟都幾乎一樣。對我嘅膚色嚟講太白咗。我只係中淺膚色啫，每隻用喺我面都超白。顯色度差，推開又唔夠滑。付咗錢但唔鍾意，好sad。包裝就好正。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
